question: What result follows from worshipping Durgā on a kula lunar day?
premises: Durgā is worshipped on a kula lunar day
Durgā becomes a giver of boons
inference: Worshipping Durgā on a kula lunar day makes her grant boons.
plain_english: Likewise, when worshipped on a kula lunar day, Durgā becomes a giver of boons.
